title: Two-literal term
statement: For a dimension $n$, choose distinct coordinates $i,j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and any required signs $r,s\in\{\pm1\}$. The associated two-literal term consists, in order, of the literal at coordinate $i$ requiring $r$ and the literal at coordinate $j$ requiring $s$.
